hypothesis: Among mouse genes with experimental Gene Ontology biological-process annotations, genes annotated to learning or memory are over-represented among genes annotated to anatomical structure morphogenesis, even after removing ion channels, gap-junction channels and neurotransmission genes, and this overlap is larger than the overlap of morphogenesis with other biological-process terms of similar size.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered: after exclusions, (a) the one-sided Fisher exact test of overlap between the learning-or-memory set (GO:0007611 and is_a/part_of descendants) and the morphogenesis set (GO:0009653 and descendants) gives odds ratio > 1.5 and p < 0.001; (b) the Mantel-Haenszel odds ratio stratified by deciles of each gene's number of experimental BP annotations is > 1.5; (c) the unstratified odds ratio is above the 75th percentile of odds ratios between the morphogenesis set and every control BP term whose post-exclusion gene count is within a factor of 1.5 of the learning-or-memory set's and which is neither an ancestor nor a descendant of GO:0007611 or GO:0009653.
fail_criterion: Pre-registered: unstratified odds ratio <= 1.2 or p >= 0.05, or Mantel-Haenszel odds ratio <= 1.2, or the odds ratio at or below the median of the size-matched control terms. Outcomes meeting neither criterion are pre-registered as 'mixed' (overlap present but not specific, or explained by annotation depth).
interpretation: TAME's prediction is phrased across animals; the test uses the mouse because MGI curation gives the deepest experimental annotation of both developmental and behavioural phenotypes in a single species. 'Genes involved in morphogenesis' is GO:0009653 anatomical structure morphogenesis and 'memory and learning categories' is GO:0007611 learning or memory, each with is_a and part_of descendants. Only experimental evidence codes (EXP, IDA, IPI, IMP, IGI, IEP, HTP, HDA, HMP, HGI, HEP) are used, so electronic or sequence-similarity annotations cannot create the overlap. The universe is every gene with at least one such BP annotation, after removing NOT-qualified lines. 'Beyond the known shared ion channels, connexins and neurotransmitter machinery' is implemented by excluding from the universe every gene annotated (any evidence) to GO:0005216 ion channel activity, GO:0005243 gap junction channel activity, GO:0005921 gap junction, GO:0007268 chemical synaptic transmission, GO:0001505 regulation of neurotransmitter levels or GO:0030594 neurotransmitter receptor activity, with descendants. Only the first part of the claim is tested; its second part (memory genes appearing in cancer, regeneration and embryogenesis screens) is out of scope here.
